page.title: QRadar access
page.description: Which QRadar APIs this site's token can reach, what each one feeds here, and what to ask the QRadar administrator for. Times are UTC.

forbidden.heading: QRadar access cannot be shown to this account.
forbidden.body: Reading it and starting a check needs the <perm>admin:*</perm> permission. The read-only role does not include it. Nothing was changed.

noConsole.heading: No QRadar console is enabled.
noConsole.body: There is nothing to check. Enable a console first; its APIs are listed here once it is.

error.couldNotRead: Could not read the QRadar access results.
error.advice: Nothing was changed and nothing was sent to QRadar. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again.
error.refreshFailed: The last refresh failed. The results below are from the read before it.

check.heading: Check now
check.note: Sends one minimal read to each API, in the worker. Nothing is written to QRadar.
check.running: A check is running. This page reads the result every {seconds, number} s.
check.timedOut: The check is still running in the worker. This page stopped reading after {minutes, number} min. Reload the page to read the result.
check.alreadyRunning: A check was already running on {consoles}. Nothing was queued for it.
check.failed: The queue refused the check for {consoles}. Nothing ran there. Try again in a minute.
check.limitedAfter: Too many checks were requested. Try again in {seconds, number} s.
check.limitedLater: Too many checks were requested. Try again in a minute.
check.forbidden: Your role cannot start a check. It needs the <perm>admin:*</perm> permission. Nothing was started.
check.error: The check could not be requested (HTTP {status}). Nothing ran. Try again.
check.errorNoAnswer: The check could not be requested: the backend did not answer. Nothing ran. Try again.

console.notApplicable: This console is not on the direct REST provider. Nothing is checked there.
console.neverChecked: No check has finished on this console yet.

verdict.allOk: Every API the application uses is reachable with this token.
verdict.refused: {count, plural, one {# API is} other {# APIs are}} refused: {names}.
verdict.unauthorized: QRadar does not accept the token itself (HTTP 401). The other statuses below say nothing about what it may read until it is replaced.
verdict.notAnswered: No API refused the token, but {count, plural, one {# did} other {# did}} not answer: {names}.
verdict.partlyUnchecked: No API refused the token. {count, plural, one {# API is} other {# APIs are}} not checked yet: {names}.
verdict.notChecked: Not checked yet. The first check runs at start-up; use Check now to run it earlier.

entry.noDetails: No further calls or sources are listed for this API.

ask.heading: What to ask for
ask.hint: IBM's role table suggests: {hint}. This is a hint. Confirm it with your QRadar administrator.
ask.verified: Required capability: {capability}. IBM states this for the API.
ask.none: IBM documents no capability for this API. Ask your QRadar administrator which role grants read access to it.
ask.notFound: QRadar answered 404: this version does not offer the API. A capability will not change that.
ask.unauthorized: The token itself was refused. Replace or re-issue it, then press Check now. A capability cannot help until the token is accepted.
